name: drawio-aws-arch-skill
description: Zero-dependency Node.js (.mjs) agent skill that scans Terraform (.tf) files and generates AWS architecture diagrams (.drawio + .drawio.png) focusing on compute/API/data layers while omitting Security Groups and IAM by default

scripts.demo: node scripts/build-aws-arch.mjs --tf-dir examples/sample-terraform --output examples/output/aws-arch-default.drawio.png --json-out examples/output/aws-arch-default.json && node scripts/build-aws-arch.mjs --tf-dir examples/sample-terraform --include security --output examples/output/aws-arch-with-sg.drawio.png
